Pune Software Engineer Accused of Killing Girlfriend, Then Calling Police

In Pune, Maharashtra, a software engineer allegedly beat his girlfriend to death following an argument in the Hinjawadi area. The accused reportedly stayed with the body overnight before contacting the police himself the following morning. Authorities were called to the scene.
